title: The Wixen brand
summary: Brand guidelines for the Wixen family: the fox mark, asset files, alt text, three-colour palette with contrast floors, type scale, and usage rules.
notes: Prose-heavy design guideline document with rationale. Contains some constraint-like content (contrast floors enforced as tests, family rule, minimum type multiplier) that reads SPEC-adjacent, but there are no APIs, schemas, or protocol definitions and no decision/consequences or user-story sections. Classified DOC.
